issues.message: 159 blocks, over the module budget of 60 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
13 layers tall: builders reach 9 without scaffolding, which isn't verified in game yet.
No door on the front half (z = 0 is the front, toward the easel).
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.detail: Shell level: arrow slits, door step, inside torches, barrels and a chest; outside faces are still plain.
notes.roof: Wall-piece top: a corbelled ring of upside-down stairs at y7 and merlons at y8 read well as an archer platform.
notes.depth: The corbel ring and cobble/mossy patches break the faces; shadows show.
notes.life: Nothing living and no light on the outside.
notes.shape: A plain square box, as expected for L1.

visual.summary: Square stone-brick wall tower the wall walk passes through at y5, with a town-side door, an inside stair up to the walk room and a crenellated archer platform.
problems: West opening of the wall walk is only 1 wide (x0 z1, y5-6) while the walk and the east side (x4 z1-2) are 2 wide: (0,5,2) and (0,6,2) are solid, so the walk narrows when it enters from the west; open them to match the walk profile.
Reachability: fine - 54 of 57 standing places reached; only a window sill (0,2,2), (0,6,3) and the spot beside the stair (1,5,3) are not.

issues.message: 157 blocks, over the module budget of 60 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
13 layers tall: builders reach 9 without scaffolding, which isn't verified in game yet.
No door on the front half (z = 0 is the front, toward the easel).
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.detail: Arrow-slit windows, chest, two barrels, a torch by the stair, a chest on the platform: right for the shell level, but the faces are mostly plain stone.
notes.artefacts: The front-window torch at (3,6,2) has nothing to hang on (floating at L1, on iron bars at L2/L3), so it drops in game. Use a lantern on a block or a wall torch on solid stone. Torch at (3,6,2) floats in the front window; the empty x0/x6 ring breaks the join with the wall pieces.
notes.roof: Crenellated archer platform: merlons at x1/3/5 on every side over a corbel ring of upside-down stairs. The automatic roof warning is the usual one for a flat-topped wall piece; ignore it.
notes.depth: Cobblestone patches and the corbel ring break the walls a little. The corbels sit in the wall line, so they don't stick out and cast no shadow.
notes.levels: L1 is the base. L3's cone roof is clearly different; L2 is close to it (see L2).
notes.purpose: The door warning is expected: the field side is the front (z1, where the wall's parapet is) and the door is on the town side (z5).

visual.summary: Level 1: a 5 x 5 stone-brick tower that the 2-wide wall walk passes through at y5, with an inside stair from the town-side door up to the walk room and a crenellated archer platform.
problems: The front-window torch at (3,6,2) has nothing to hang on (floating at L1, on iron bars at L2/L3), so it drops in game. Use a lantern on a block or a wall torch on solid stone.

Floating wall torch at (3,6,2) facing south: the block it hangs on, (3,6,1), is the open window, so the torch hangs in the air. Move it to a solid wall face, e.g. (2,6,2) or (4,6,2) against stone bricks (2,6,1)/(4,6,1).

Joining: the 7 x 7 box puts the tower walls at x1..5 and z1..5, so x0 and x6 are empty from y0 to y8. Placed box to box beside stone_wall_straight v2 (3 deep: parapet z0, 2-wide walk z1-2 with floor at y4), this leaves a 1-block air gap at x0 and x6 with no walk floor, and the tower's walk (z2-3) sits 1 block behind the wall's walk (z1-2). Either fill x0/x6 with the wall profile (floor (0,4,2..3) and (6,4,2..3), parapet at z1), or state the (-1,-1) placement offset in the meta so the layout overlaps the empty ring.
Last round fixed: the walk now enters 2 wide from both sides (y5-6 at z2-3 are open at x1 and x5).

Reachability: fine. 75 of 77 standing places are reached; only the window sill (1,2,3) and the spot beside the stair (2,5,4) are not, and the walk room, the stair and the archer platform are all reached.
